In a futuristic society governed by a ruthless AI system that measures a person's psychological state to predict criminal intent before it even happens, an idealistic enforcer begins to question the absolute justice of his world. As he tracks down a mastermind who has found a way to bypass the system, he discovers terrifying truths about the foundations of his civilization. Torn between absolute obedience and the pursuit of free will, he must decide whether to protect the very regime that defines him or risk everything to destroy it.
